name: Formation Frenzy
shortDescription: Drag dancers into position to match target formations before time runs out! A fast-paced puzzle game inspired by halftime dance choreography on the football field.

generation.notes: Inspired by football halftime dance squads forming choreographed patterns. Features 12 formations including Line, V Shape, Diamond, Star, Circle, Arrow, Cross, Triangle, Wave, Heart, Zigzag, and Spiral.
